goal: Refactor HomeViewModel and related components to fix null-safety in routeName parsing and eliminate unsafe '!!' operator usage, ensuring robust data handling across the UI and Domain layers.
feedback: HomeViewModel을 포함하여 HomeScreen, AfterRegisterMap, LastTimer 등 관련 UI 컴포넌트 전체에서 위험한 '!!' 연산자를 모두 제거했습니다. Kotlin의 안전한 호출(?.), 엘비스 연산자(?:), 그리고 smart cast를 활용한 로컬 변수 캡처 등을 사용하여 널 안정성을 확보했습니다. 모든 변경 사항이 반영된 상태에서 빌드 검증(assembleDebug)이 성공적으로 완료되었음을 확인했습니다.

steps.description: Identify all occurrences of '!!' operator and unsafe parsing logic in HomeViewModel related to routeName and API responses.
Refactor data layer DTOs and Domain layer Models to ensure routeName is handled as a nullable type or with safe defaults.
Update HomeViewModel to use safe calls (?.), elvis operators (?:), or scope functions (let, also) instead of forced non-null assertions.
Eliminate remaining unsafe '!!' assertions in related UI components (HomeScreen, LastTimer, AfterRegisterMap).
Verify the refactor by ensuring the application builds successfully and unit tests pass.
